scope: Read-only source/header graph analysis; no Lean, Lake, native Windows, C#, CI, or runtime benchmarks.

model.unit: One module transaction (compile/restore plus required audit and acceptance). All units are assumed equal only for this model.
model.external_prerequisites: Compatible externally compiled dependency artifacts are present and freshly verified before local work.
model.cache_hit_cost: Set to zero only in the warm-six-node structural model; actual hashing/restoration takes time.
model.module_release_barrier: Successful exact artifact identity and standard-axiom audit accepted by the parent coordinator.

cold_local_graph.priority_rule: Descending remaining critical-path length, then original compile-order position.

warm_84_old_ordinary_modules_verified.priority_rule: Descending remaining critical-path length, then original compile-order position.

native_process_counts_from_existing_cont.exclusions: Compiler/version queries, hashing, cache migration, and any audit-only refreshes; counts are conditional source deductions, not observed runs.

recommendation.thread_rule: Sum of launch-time thread reservations across all live compile/audit processes must not exceed the configured budget; no retrospective increase to a running process.

ram_policy.status: Suggested conservative starting policy; no process-RAM observations are available.
ram_policy.planned_read_only_mapping_sidecar_reserv: Also reserve the sidecar's announced maximum charged-page cap, conservatively even if clean file-backed pages overlap Lean mappings; the sidecar is not a residency guarantee or shared Lean environment.
ram_policy.admission: Cap workers by min(4, ready work, CPU token budget, free-RAM reservations). Recheck RAM before each launch and reserve for active processes not yet at their estimated peak.
ram_policy.unknown_ram_fallback: One Lean process; report that memory-based admission was unavailable.
ram_policy.low_ram_fallback: Use one process when the reserve permits one; if even one cannot be admitted, wait/recheck and give an actionable resource message instead of spawning more workers.
ram_policy.measurement_limit: 4 GiB is an adjustable admission estimate, not a memory cap or guarantee. Native evidence is needed before tuning it downward.

recommendation.cache_identity: Preserve SCHEMA, COMPILE_POLICY, AUDIT_POLICY, COMPILE_FLAGS, source hashes, local/external dependency fingerprints, and exact audit targets. Worker count, thread budget, and RAM observations are runtime provenance only.

integration_requirements: Use one coordinator and the existing workspace lock. Only compiler/audit child processes run concurrently; coordinator serializes cache verification, state acceptance, and immutable receipt commits.
Build ready queues from the actual verified local import graph, preserving compile-order position only as a deterministic tie-breaker.
Try validated anchor reuse for each ready module before occupying a Lean worker. A ready cache hit can immediately unblock its dependents.
Do not publish moduleKeys/artifactHashes at compile exit. Audit-only restores and fresh compiles release dependents only after the existing acceptance/save path succeeds.
Count compile and audit child processes in the same CPU/RAM pool. Keep generated audit source, output family, and log paths unique per module.
Failure blocks only the transitive dependents; independent ready modules remain eligible. Global hash/transport failures remain fatal.
Drain or safely account for every owned live child before releasing the workspace lock or reporting final completion. Preserve per-module failure stage and logs.
Keep the selected aggregate as a final barrier after all ordinary modules are accepted, preserving the exact 370-target audit and mathematical status reporting.
Fresh operation-scoped content verification remains mandatory; parallelism does not authorize persistent digest reuse or trusting unverified working artifacts.
Avoid unbudgeted overlap of a 16-thread hashing helper with a full 16-thread Lean pool; account for that work or perform the coordinator's hash phases at controlled boundaries.
implementation_blockers_in_current_runne: runToFile uses synchronous shell.Run(..., true); the existing processModuleBody cannot run asynchronously as written.
processModuleBody combines cache restore, compile, audit, and receipt commit in one synchronous call; a scheduler needs explicit per-module phase records.
The main loop processes ordered modules serially, and stage is one mutable global; parallel status must retain each task's stage without weakening final error reporting.
No current RAM admission probe/reservation or compiler worker pool exists. Thread count is currently a per-process jobs value.
